hypothesis: Original M95 middle FFN processes each middle token independently. A fixed same-original-parent geometric MST can instead generate a signed nonlinear contrast at each real edge and deliver equal/opposite updates to its endpoints before original HCG. This may alter local boundary/detail evidence in the actual inst_feats mask path; whether such a deficit or gain exists is UNKNOWN.

variables.input: Original middle pre-norm tokens x=LN1(rawcf), original parent IDs ids2, true point support ids1[ids0], existing detached per_layer_coords[2].
variables.operator: For each MST undirectededge(i,j), q=f([xi,xj])-f([xj,xi]), f=GELU(Linear2C->C); delta_i+=q,delta_j-=q; refinedmiddle=rawcf+delta.
variables.fine_coarse: Original M95 FFN/LN/skip at fine and coarse unchanged.
variables.output: Original rawCSORT/HCG/gate/message_norm and single inst_feats writeback remain.

matched_control: Original M95 same original YAML/data/pretrain/seed1999/epochs50/max_iters70/native loader TRAIN2 and original prediction-resource protocol. The full architecture substitution is tested; not single-factor causal attribution.
causal_path_to_test: Original native loss must backpropagate through actual signed incidence, both actual orientations of the shared edge_map/GELU, then HCG->singleinst->original prediction/loss.
scope: A same-parent nonlinear signed edge-incidence family alternative, not attention/novelty/coverage/mean-preserving RSTR repair.

nearest_routes.RSTR: Old held fine-leaf pi=count nonnegative reversible MarkovP(X)X; AEF middle dense cross-channel signed nonlinear q on fixed geometry, not a convex/Markov transport and generally NOT point-mass/π weighted-mean preserving. Oldhold/R2status unchanged.
nearest_routes.MDC: Original6direction nearest stencil/depthwise+pointwise one-hop; AEF MST pairMLP applied to two orientations and coupled +q/-q endpoints, not kernel-size tuning.
nearest_routes.CTS_BFC: They replace all n states through repeated composition; AEF is one flux pass on a tree and does not give all-parent one-forward reception.
nearest_routes.BEC: BEC changes cross-level up/down roles; AEF keeps fine/coarse M95 and changes onlymiddle. This narrower scope is explicit.
nearest_routes.BTC_BCR_PSBR: No inside/outside or prefix/suffix/inclusive state compression/scan. MST connectivity is topology, not recurrent globalcontext.

algebraic_properties_only: For arbitrary q, unweighted sum ofmiddle delta perparent is zero in real arithmetic. FP32 scatter error is unmeasured; no bitwise/conservation or information-losslessness claim.
Swapping edgeorientation also negatesq, so endpoint delta algebra is unchanged.
n<=1 has noedge and delta0: no fallback to originalmiddleFFN. Constant equal sibling inputs yield q0 in real arithmetic.
risks: Onehop MST neighborhoods can miss nonlocal siblings, unlike full-parent composition.
Large tree degree and unscaled sum can amplify activation/gradients; the original external skip is retained but no new scalar/normalization is added.
Unweighted token conservation does not preserve point-count weighted readback mean; π effect is untested, not repaired.
CPU geometry tolist/Prim O(n^2) can hurt latency despite lower linear parameter count.
Geometry ties depend on originalID tie-breaks, no relabeling/rotation/FP32 invariance claim.
NewCPUfork restores subsequent RNG position but may reuse random subsequences; common initialization/data pairing still must be measured.
novelty: UNKNOWN; bounded local route review only, no whole-literature novelty claim.
evidence_scope: Source dataflow and exact stdlib topology correctness only; no trained checkpoint/data/gradient/performance experiment performed.
